column3: WHERE t.id IN (SELECT item_id FROM favorites WHERE profile_id = 1 AND item_type = 'track' UNION SELECT t9.id FROM tracks t9 LEFT JOIN artists ar9 ON t9.artist_id = ar9.id JOIN streaming_favorites sf9 ON sf9.profile_id = 1 AND sf9.item_type = 'track' AND sf9.title IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(t9.title)) = lower(trim(sf9.title)) AND lower(trim(coalesce(ar9.name, ''))) = lower(trim(coalesce(sf9.artist, '')))) AND LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.source, ''), 'local')) = LOWER('local')
WHERE t.id NOT IN (SELECT track_id FROM listen_history WHERE track_id IS NOT NULL)
WHERE LOWER(ar.name) = LOWER('John Coltrane') AND LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.source, ''), 'local')) = LOWER('qobuz')
WHERE LOWER(t.genre) LIKE LOWER('%jazz%') ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(t.composer) = LOWER('Mozart')
WHERE t.id IN (SELECT track_id FROM playlist_tracks WHERE playlist_id = 4 AND track_id IS NOT NULL)

WHERE (t.id IN (SELECT it9.item_id FROM item_tags it9 WHERE it9.tag_id = 7 AND it9.item_type = 'track') OR t.album_id IN (SELECT it9.item_id FROM item_tags it9 WHERE it9.tag_id = 7 AND it9.item_type = 'album') OR t.artist_id IN (SELECT it9.item_id FROM item_tags it9 WHERE it9.tag_id = 7 AND it9.item_type = 'artist'))
WHERE t.id IN (SELECT track_id FROM listen_history WHERE track_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY track_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2)
WHERE LOWER(al.title) != LOWER('Kind of Blue') AND LOWER(t.label) LIKE LOWER('%Blue Note%') ESCAPE '\'
WHERE LOWER(t.file_path) LIKE LOWER('/m/jazz%') ESCAPE '\' AND LOWER(t.comments) LIKE LOWER('%live%') ESCAPE '\'
